limits_hint: Limits for every profile. A tariff, profile, device or server can overwrite them.
tariffs_hint: A tariff sets an access term, servers and its own limits. The term and servers go to a profile when the tariff is assigned or renewed.
title_needed: Write the name in the main language.
description_needed: Write the description in the main language, or clear it in all of them.
tariff_hint: Without a term the tariff leaves a profile's term as it is. Its limits apply while it is assigned.
delete_hint: A tariff without profiles can be deleted.
delete_in_use: Profiles on this tariff: {count}. Assign them another tariff to delete it.
defaults_hint: What a new server starts with. Servers already made keep their own settings.
traffic_hint: Servers count each device's traffic. Traffic quotas need it.
traffic_waiting: The first collection runs within {minutes} min.
traffic_paused: Traffic is not counted; totals so far are kept.
delivery_hint: Servers apply connection and speed limits themselves.
delivery_line: Up to date on {current} of {total} servers.
